alt: Old Yongsu, sitting up whole in his night robe, laughs a beat late at Kangrim, who reads a line in the red ledger twice.
scene: Tenebrist two-shot at the threshold of death, the small bedroom of the house by the stream in Surabol, just before dawn — the world already falling away into black around the two of them; no one else exists in this frame. ONLY TWO FIGURES: Kim Yongsu, very old, thin, white hair loose over his shoulders with the one stray strand still poking straight up, in a plain white sleeping robe, sitting up whole at the edge of the sleeping mat, head thrown back in a crooked delighted laugh, as if one of the dead has finally answered him. Facing him, Kangrim the reaper: black wide-brimmed gat, crow-dark robe, a red ledger open in one hand, polite as a clerk, his head tilted over one line of the ledger as if it puzzles him. The dead body is NOT in this frame. One hard key only: a low brazier by the wall, its ember light raking across both faces and the folds of their robes, a cool blue #6a7cb0 dawn edge from the lattice window behind Yongsu, everything else crushed to black; long shadows climbing the plaster wall. Quiet, solemn, a little funny — a meeting, not a fight. No glow aura, no ghost-blue tint, no transparency: the dead man is drawn solid and whole.

at: Don’t you dare go on ahead of me.
alt: Old Chunmyung, sitting up straight in her night robe, ignores Haewonmek and gives her husband one last order.
scene: Tenebrist two-shot at the threshold of death, the small bedroom of the house by the stream in Surabol, just before dawn — the world already falling away into black around the two of them; no one else exists in this frame. ONLY TWO FIGURES: Princess Chunmyung, very old, silver hair pinned up with her gold amethyst binyeo, in a plain white sleeping robe, sitting up whole and straight-backed on the sleeping mat, not looking at the reaper at all but sideways out of frame toward her husband, mouth set, dry and commanding, one hand flat on the blanket. Across the lamp from her, Haewonmek the second reaper: black wide-brimmed gat, black robe, a red book open in one hand, standing very still, his sword left sheathed at his hip, waiting for her last words with something close to respect. The dead body is NOT in this frame. One hard key only: a single oil lamp on the floor between them, lilac #d8a0e8 catching her silk and the binyeo, raking up both faces, everything else crushed to black; long shadows climbing the plaster wall. Quiet, solemn, intimate — a meeting, not a fight. No glow aura, no ghost-blue tint, no transparency: the dead woman is drawn solid and whole.
